title: UCIe-style Die-to-Die Adapter: 68-byte flits for two protocol stacks, capability exchange and the Adapter link state machine over the sideband, L1, retrain, and Retry (CRC-16, sequence numbers, Ack / Nak, replay buffer and timer)

fields.desc: enable the link: with phy_up the Adapter starts the capability exchange; clearing it returns to RESET and clears everything
Retry capability advertised in AdvCap (taken when the link starts)
stack 1 capability advertised in AdvCap (taken when the link starts)
accept L1 requests from the far side
request L1 when the link is idle (armed again once cleared)

regs.name: TX
regs.desc: 64-byte flit payload to send and its stack; writing the last word sends it (the Adapter takes it in ACTIVE when the replay buffer has room and no replay is running; in L1 it wakes the link)

fdesc.tx_stack: protocol stack (1 is dropped unless negotiated)

regs.name: RX
regs.desc: 64-byte payload received and its stack; reading the last word pops it. A payload arriving while RX is full is lost (RX_OVF)

fields.desc: link state: 0 RESET, 1 PARAM, 2 ACTREQ, 3 ACTIVE, 4 L1, 5 RETRAIN, 6 LINKERROR
flits sent and not yet acknowledged

irqs.name: CRC
irqs.desc: a flit with a bad CRC was received and dropped

irqs.name: REPLAY
irqs.desc: a replay started: a Nak from the far side, or the replay timeout

irqs.name: RETRAIN
irqs.desc: NR replays without progress: a retrain was requested (lp_retrain)

irqs.name: PMNAK
irqs.desc: the far side refused an L1 request

irqs.name: PROTO
irqs.desc: a sideband message not expected in the state, or a flit dropped (wrong state, RTY mismatch, stack 1 not negotiated)

irqs.name: LINKERR
irqs.desc: LINKERROR entered: FinCap mismatch, handshake timeout, or a bad CRC without Retry

features: 68-byte flits: a 2-byte header {DATA, STACK, NAK, RTY, SEQ, ACK}, a 64-byte payload, a CRC-16.
Two protocol stacks multiplexed on one link; stack 1 only when both sides advertise it.
Capability exchange (AdvCap / FinCap) and the Active handshake (Req.Active / Rsp.Active) over a sideband, with a handshake timeout.
Adapter link state machine: RESET, PARAM, ACTREQ, ACTIVE, L1, RETRAIN, LINKERROR.
L1 entry from either side (Req.L1 / Rsp.L1 / Rsp.PMNAK), crossed requests, exit on traffic.
Retrain on phy_up loss, keeping the Retry state and replaying what is outstanding; a retrain request after NR replays without progress.
Retry: sequence numbers, Ack / Nak, an RB-entry replay buffer and a replay timer. Without Retry a bad CRC is a link error.
notes: lt_valid / lt_flit and lr_valid / lr_flit are the 68-byte flit interface to the physical layer, phy_up / lp_retrain its status and retrain request, and sb_tx_valid / sb_tx_msg and sb_rx_valid / sb_rx_msg the sideband; they pass through unchanged.
The core parameters RB (8), TO (64), NR (4) and HT (512) keep their defaults.
Field layouts, message codes and the CRC are ours; they follow the UCIe Adapter's structure but have not been checked against another UCIe Adapter.
sequence: Write CTRL with link_en set (and the capabilities wanted); poll STATUS until state reads 3 (ACTIVE) and check cap.
Send: write TX0..TX15 (payload) and TX16 (stack); the last write commits it. Receive: on RX_AVAIL read RX0..RX16; reading RX16 pops it.
Set pm_req to let the link enter L1 when idle; a TX write wakes it.
On LINKERR, clear link_en, then set it again to restart the link.
